title.zh: 无状态散列基数字签名标准（FIPS 205）

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh.principle: **标准**：无状态散列基数字签名标准（FIPS 205）（Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard (SLH-DSA)）。FIPS 205 批准的是哈希基签名的参数集：「This standard specifies several parameter sets for SLH-DSA that are approved for use.Additional parameter sets may be specified and approved in future NIST Special Publications.」——批准边界只到今天列出的档位。
zh.why: 它把安全性建立在哈希假设上：§1 写「The security of the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA) relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions as well as several related properties of the same hash functions.」，并把自己与既有签名标准区分开——「Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 …, SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer.」
zh.used: 运维约束与前两份签名标准一致：「Agencies are advised that digital signature key pairs shall not be used for other purposes.」这份文档对签名量的说法只到结构层面：§3 写「Conceptually, an SLH-DSA key pair consists of a very large set of FORS key pairs.」并把 FORS 定性为「a few-time signature scheme」，同段给出限额含义：「The few-time signature scheme FORS allows each key pair to safely sign a small number of messages.」标准给出的是构造与参数上限，未把`挪作他用`另立禁令。
zh.broken: 限度一是整体系统安全仍由部署方负责：「The responsible authority in each agency or department shall ensure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security.」限度二是批准范围只向新增开放——正文写明「Additional parameter sets may be specified and approved in future NIST Special Publications」，即由未来的特别出版物追加参数集，本文件不承诺覆盖全部未来形态，也未给出撤销既有档位的通道。
zh.history: 身份行是「Announcing the Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard」，编号与名称在 FIPS 205 的说明节给出，法源句是一整句「Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) publications are developed by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) under 15 U.S.C.278g-3 and issued by the Secretary of Commerce under 40 U.S.C.11331.」；它与 203/204 同批发布。摘要交代了血统：「SLH-DSA is based on SPHINCS+, which was selected for standardization as part of the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization process.」；有状态的一支另由 SP 800-208「Recommendation for Stateful Hash-Based Signature Schemes」处理，而本文件的组件用法被明确限制——WOTS+、XMSS、FORS 与 hypertree 不是独立批准的签名方案，模块不应向外暴露这些组件接口。

en.principle: **Standard**: Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard (SLH-DSA) (无状态散列基数字签名标准（FIPS 205）). FIPS 205 approves parameter sets for hash-based signatures: "This standard specifies several parameter sets for SLH-DSA that are approved for use. Additional parameter sets may be specified and approved in future NIST Special Publications." — approval extends only as far as the listed sets.
en.why: It rests on hash assumptions: clause 1 states "The security of the stateless hash-based digital signature algorithm (SLH-DSA) relies on the presumed difficulty of finding preimages for hash functions as well as several related properties of the same hash functions." and separates itself from the incumbent — "Unlike the algorithms specified in FIPS 186-5 …, SLH-DSA is designed to provide resistance against attacks from a large-scale quantum computer."
en.used: The operational constraint matches the other signature standards: "Agencies are advised that digital signature key pairs shall not be used for other purposes." What the document itself says is structural: clause 3 states "Conceptually, an SLH-DSA key pair consists of a very large set of FORS key pairs." and characterises FORS as "a few-time signature scheme", adding that "The few-time signature scheme FORS allows each key pair to safely sign a small number of messages." — the standard supplies construction and parameter limits, without adding a separate prohibition on other uses.
en.broken: First limit: whole-system security remains the deployer’s duty — "The responsible authority in each agency or department shall ensure that an overall implementation provides an acceptable level of security." Second, the approval scope is open-ended in one direction only: new parameter sets are left to "future NIST Special Publications", so this document promises no coverage of future forms.
en.history: The announcement line is "Announcing the Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard", with number and name in the explanation clause and the standing authority sentence "Federal Information Processing Standards (FIPS) publications are developed by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) under 15 U.S.C. 278g-3 and issued by the Secretary of Commerce under 40 U.S.C. 11331." It was published with FIPS 203 and 204, and the abstract gives its lineage — "SLH-DSA is based on SPHINCS+, which was selected for standardization as part of the NIST Post-Quantum Cryptography Standardization process." The stateful branch is handled elsewhere, by SP 800-208, "Recommendation for Stateful Hash-Based Signature Schemes"; inside this standard the components are not approved stand-alone schemes, so modules should not expose WOTS+, XMSS, FORS and hypertree interfaces.

**Formal model and reproduction steps**

\[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\]

Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Standard (SLH-DSA): the registered public parameters, key material or randomness, and message are mapped through the stated transformation to an output checked against the registered criterion. The worked example is a structural reproduction, not a new test vector; parameter ranges, standard versions and implementation details remain source-bound.

zh: SLH-DSA：状态无关哈希签名算法的构造名。
stateless：无需跟踪一次性密钥消耗状态。
parameter set：标准批准的具体参数档位。
hash-based：安全性仅建立在哈希原语上。
NIST Special Publication：未来新增参数集的发布载体。
WOTS+/FORS：SLH-DSA 内部的组件签名方案，分别是一次性与少次签名，均不单独批准。
en: SLH-DSA: the stateless hash-based signature construction name.
Stateless: no need to track one-time-key consumption.
Parameter set: a configuration approved by the standard.
Hash-based: security resting only on hash primitives.
NIST Special Publication: the vehicle for future parameter sets.
WOTS+ / FORS: the component schemes inside SLH-DSA — one-time and few-time signing, neither approved stand-alone.
